'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)|War in Afghanistan]]
**[[2021 Afghanistan attacks]]
***Three female media workers are shot dead in [[Jalalabad]], [[Nangarhar]], while a fourth woman is wounded. The [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant – Khorasan Province|Islamic State]] claims responsibility for the attack. [https://www.reuters.com/article/BigStory12/idUSKCN2AV0GB (Reuters)]
*[[Zamfara kidnapping]]
**All 279 schoolgirls abducted from a [[boarding school]] in [[Zamfara State]], [[Nigeria]], are released by their armed [[kidnap]]pers. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-nigeria-security-kidnappng/all-abducted-nigerian-schoolgirls-freed-by-kidnappers-zamfara-state-governor-idUSKCN2AU0BY?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**[[Islamic terrorism|Islamic terrorist]] group [[Al-Shabaab (militant group)|al-Shabaab]] [[Public execution|publicly executes]] five people by [[firing squad]] for allegedly [[spying]] for the [[federal government of the United States|American]] and [[government of Somalia|Somali]] [[intelligence agencies]] in [[Jilib]], [[Middle Juba]]. Hundreds of people reportedly gathered to watch the execution. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/africa/somalia-al-shabaab-executes-5-people-for-spying/2162149 (Anadolu Agency)]
*[[2020–2021 Sudanese–Ethiopian clashes]]
**Fighting between Sudan and Ethiopian-backed forces continues in the last Ethiopian stronghold of Bereket in the disputed border region of Al-Fashaga. Sudan claims Eritrean forces are helping the Ethiopians. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/africa/sudan-army-pushes-to-control-disputed-area-with-ethiopia/2162126 (Anadolu Agency)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Anti-Irish sentiment]]
**The [[Equality and Human Rights Commission]] says that it has investigated [[Britannia Hotels]]-owned holiday park operator [[Pontins]] after a [[whistleblower]] revealed Pontins had a [[blacklist]] of common [[Irish people|Irish]] surnames to prevent Roma and Irish travelers from booking at its parks. [[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|Prime Minister]] [[Boris Johnson]] says the discrimination is "completely unacceptable". [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-56246848 (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Imperial County car crash]]
**Thirteen people are killed and eleven others are wounded in a [[traffic accident]] in [[Imperial County, California]], US. A [[semi-truck]] and an [[sport utility vehicle|SUV]] collide; 25 people were in the SUV at the time of the crash. [https://www.latimes.com/california/story/2021-03-02/mass-fatality-crash-reported-on-imperial-county-highway (''The Los Angeles Times'')]
*[[Mount Sinabung]] in [[Sumatra]], [[Indonesia]] erupts, spewing 16,000 feet of ash into the air. [https://www.cbsnews.com/amp/news/mount-sinabung-volcano-eruption-indonesia/ (CBS News)]
*Seven students are killed in a railing collapse, sending people plummeting from a fourth-floor balcony on to an atrium floor during a student assembly at the [[Universidad Pública de El Alto]], [[Bolivia]]. Three people are arrested. [https://www.europapress.es/internacional/noticia-detenidas-bolivia-tres-personas-convocar-asamblea-murieron-siete-alumnos-caer-cuarto-piso-20210303144607.html (Europa Press)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Mississippi]]
*****[[Mississippi]] [[Governor of Mississippi|Governor]] [[Tate Reeves]] signs an executive order that lifts the statewide [[Face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|mask requirement]] except for K-12 schools and indoor arenas. Indoor arenas are required to limit their capacity to 50% and club areas and suits to 75%. Indoor and outdoor arenas are required to limit capacity to 25% and 50% respectively for K-12 extracurricular activities. [https://www.sunherald.com/news/coronavirus/article249632763.html (''Sun Herald'')] 
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Oregon]], [[Lineage P.1]]
*****[[Oregon]] reports its first cases of the Lineage P.1 variant in two people from [[Douglas County, Oregon|Douglas County]] who previously travelled to [[Brazil]]. [https://www.oregonlive.com/coronavirus/2021/03/brazilian-variant-of-covid-19-identified-in-oregons-douglas-county.html (OregonLive)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Texas]]
*****[[Texas]] [[Governor of Texas|Governor]] [[Greg Abbott]] lifts the statewide [[Face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|mask requirement]] and allows businesses to open at 100% capacity beginning March 10. [https://thehill.com/policy/healthcare/541272-texas-governor-lifts-state-mask-mandate-other-covid-restrictions (''The Hill'')]
****[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Joe Biden]] announces that [[Merck & Co.]] will produce single-shot [[Johnson & Johnson COVID-19 vaccine|Johnson & Johnson]] [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]] to help his [[Presidency of Joe Biden|administration]] goal for vaccinating every adult by the end of May. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/health/2021/03/02/merck-johnson-and-johnson-covid-vaccine-partnership/ (''The Washington Post'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Manitoba]], [[501.V2 variant]]
*****[[Manitoba]] reports its first two cases of the 501.V2 variant first detected in [[South Africa]] in [[Winnipeg]]. [https://www.cbc.ca/amp/1.5933451 (CBC)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia]], [[Lineage B.1.1.7]]
****[[Indonesia]] reports its first two cases of the Lineage B.1.1.7 variant first detected in the [[United Kingdom]]. [https://www.liputan6.com/health/read/4496121/wamenkes-varian-baru-virus-corona-covid-19-dari-inggris-ditemukan-di-indonesia (Liputan6.com)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iraq]]
****[[Iraq]] receives 50,000 doses of the [[Sinopharm]] [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]]s donated by [[China]] as the country officially begins its [[vaccination]] campaign. [https://english.aawsat.com/home/article/2836156/iraq-receives-50000-sinopharm-covid-19-vaccines-china (Asharq Al-Awsat)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Mongolia]]
****[[Mongolia]] surpasses 3,000 cases of [[COVID-19]]. [https://www.montsame.mn/en/read/255362 (Montsame)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Malaysia]]
****[[Malaysia]] grants conditional approval for the use of the [[Oxford-AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine|Oxford-AstraZeneca]] and [[Sinovac]] [[CoronaVac]] vaccines. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/covid-19-malaysia-approves-sinovac-astrazeneca-vaccines-uk-china-14316202 (CNA)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines]], [[501.V2 variant]]
****The [[Philippines]] reports its first six cases of the 501.V2 variant first detected in [[South Africa]]. [https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/news/nation/777941/philippines-detects-south-african-coronavirus-variant/story/ (GMA News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Saudi Arabia]], [[impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on Hajj]]
****[[Saudi Arabia|Saudi]] [[Ministry of Health (Saudi Arabia)|Minister of Health]] [[Tawfig Al-Rabiah]] announces that all pilgrims must be vaccinated against COVID-19 in order to do the [[Hajj]] to [[Mecca]]. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/1818441/saudi-arabia (''Arab News'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in United Arab Emirates]]
****Spanish media reports that emeritus [[King of Spain]] [[Juan Carlos I]] was vaccinated in [[Abu Dhabi]], where he is in self-exile. Two of his daughters [[Infanta Elena, Duchess of Lugo|Infanta Elena]] and [[Infanta Cristina of Spain|Infanta Cristina]] also received vaccines when they took advantage of a visit to their father on February 6 and 7. [https://www.elconfidencial.com/espana/2021-03-02/infantas-elena-cristina-vacunaron-coronavirus-emiratos-aprovechando-visita-juan-carlos-i_2974843/ (''El Confidencial'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Greece]]
****[[Greece]] reports 2,353 new cases in the past 24 hours, which is the highest single-day total this year, bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 194,582. [https://greekcitytimes.com/2021/03/03/greece-registers-2353-new-coronavirus-cases-on-tuesday-with-422-patients-in-icus-nationwide/ (Greek City Times)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]], [[Lineage B.1.1.7]]
****[[Prime Minister of Italy|Prime Minister]] [[Mario Draghi]] signs a decree that orders the closure of all [[school]]s in the worst-hit [[Regions of Italy|region]]s due to the spread of the Lineage B.1.1.7 variant. The decree will be in effective from March 6 until April 6. [https://www.euronews.com/2021/03/02/coronavirus-italian-government-shuts-all-schools-in-high-risk-areas (Eurozone)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Moldova]], [[COVID-19 vaccine]]
****[[Moldova]] begins their [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccination]] campaign, with first-line medical staff being administered first. [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/europe/2021-03/03/c_139778939.htm (Xinhua News Agency)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Serbia]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in Bosnia and Herzegovina]]
****[[President of Serbia|President]] [[Aleksandar Vučić]] delivers 10,000 doses of the [[Oxford–AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine|Oxford–AstraZeneca]] vaccine to the [[Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina|Bosniak and Croat-dominated federation entity]] in [[Bosnia and Herzegovina]]. [https://balkaninsight.com/2021/03/02/serbias-vucic-delivers-covid-19-vaccines-to-bosnia/ (Balkan Insight)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ukraine]]
****[[President of Ukraine|President]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyi]] receives his first dose of [[Oxford–AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine|Oxford–AstraZeneca vaccine]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/Health/wireStory/ukraines-leader-vaccine-shot-dispel-public-doubts-76208269 (ABC News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Africa]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Angola]]
****[[Angola]] receives 624,000 doses of the [[Oxford–AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine|Oxford–AstraZeneca]] vaccine through the [[COVAX]] vaccine-sharing Initiative. [https://www.voaportugues.com/amp/angola-recebe-primeiras-vacinas-do-cons%C3%B3rcio-covax/5798423.html (VOA Portuguese)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Kenya]]
****[[Kenya]] receives 1.02 million doses of the [[Oxford–AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine|Oxford–AstraZeneca]] vaccine through the [[COVAX]] vaccine-sharing Initiative. [https://www.unicef.org/kenya/press-releases/over-1-million-covid-19-vaccine-doses-arrive-nairobi-via-covax-facility (UNICEF)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Nigeria]]
****[[Nigeria]] receives 3.94 million doses of the [[Oxford–AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine|Oxford–AstraZeneca]] vaccine manufactured by the [[Serum Institute of India]] through the [[COVAX]] Initiative, which is the largest delivery so far by the initiative. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/nigeria-receives-million-vaccines-covax-76198417 (ABC News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Tunisia]], [[Lineage B.1.1.7]]
****[[Tunisia]] reports its first case of the Lineage B.1.1.7 variant first detected in the [[United Kingdom]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/health-coronavirus-tunisia/tunisia-detects-first-cases-of-british-coronavirus-variant-idUSL2N2L01PR (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in South America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in Brazil]]
*****Former [[Brazil national football team|Brazilian]] [[Association football|footballer]] [[Pelé]] receives his first dose of the [[COVID-19 vaccine]]. [https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/37614686/brazil-great-pele-gets-covid-19-vaccine-urges-social-responsibility-virus-fight (ESPN)] [https://www.reuters.com/sports/soccer-former-soccer-star-pele-gets-vaccinated-brazil-2021-03-03/ (Reuters)]
****[[Brazil]] reports a record 1,641 new deaths in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 257,361. [https://www.dw.com/pt-br/brasil-registra-1641-mortes-por-covid-19-pior-marca-desde-o-in%C3%ADcio-da-pandemia/a-56752028 (DW in Brazilian Portuguese)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Venezuela]]
****[[Venezuela]] receives 500,000 doses of the [[Sinopharm]] [[BBIBP-CorV]] vaccine donated by [[China]]. [https://www.efe.com/efe/america/sociedad/venezuela-recibe-de-china-medio-millon-dosis-vacunas-contra-la-covid-19/20000013-4477429 (EFE)]
